title: Repair actual scheduled reconciliation incident causal telemetry and canonical lineage transport
summary: Repairs scheduled reconciliation incident causal telemetry linking to emit exactly one deterministic causal telemetry event ID from genuine stored owner evidence (last_heartbeat_event_id for runtime health, last_event_id for execution drift) while preserving complete provenance in evaluation records. Fails closed on missing or conflicting owner authority without mismatched cross-anchor fallback. Aligns TelemetryLineageLookup client transport and preserves docker-compose.yml canonical telemetry tenant chain unchanged, passing topology contracts without inventing credentials or falling back to benchmark corpora.

acceptance_verification.description: Diagnosed actual evaluations and incident delivery errors with exactly-one telemetry event failure and lineage transport missing errors without requesting VM credential or second lease.

Repaired _scheduled_drift_report to derive exactly one causal telemetry event ID deterministically (last_heartbeat_event_id for runtime health, last_event_id for execution drift) satisfying incidents consumer cardinality constraint (len == 1) while retaining full evaluation evidence_refs provenance and failing closed without mismatched cross-anchor fallback.

Aligned TelemetryLineageLookup to resolve PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_API_URL and PANTHEON_INCIDENTS_TENANT_ID with fail-closed error handling and unconfigured tenant remaining empty; preserved docker-compose.yml canonical telemetry tenant chain unchanged without inventing tokens or using corpus fallback as hosted truth.
Exercised genuine warning and critical incident paths in scheduled reconciliation without changing financial math, thresholds, or personas.
Six declared artifacts scoped strictly; net production lines (+15) well within budget (<= 40); verified with pytest suite and topology contract.
Source-only QA delivery ready for independent review and native delivery.
